title: The Clebsch Cubic: Hitchin's Icosahedral Double Cover and Conference-Matrix Rigidity
description: This preprint determines Hitchin's incidence double cover over harmonic cubics as Q(P(H))(√(5J₀)) and turns a marked deck sign into an order-six conference pair (C,Z) with C²=5I. Its signed triangle-product cubic is also a middle-exterior diagonal, a commutator Pfaffian, and an oriented spectral-block determinant; its translates and squares recover the Joubert–Segre and Segre–Igusa constructions. Balanced exchange rigidity characterizes order six, the single-bit aligned-four-set datum reconstructs every two-graph on at least seven vertices up to complement, and a Petersen/Gaunt realization returns the same Clebsch invariant harmonically.
